about_the_game:
Last 4 difficulties and custom mode are not available in demo version

Enter the storm in Tile Tempest, a fast-paced, physics-infused tile-matching game where precision, timing, and strategy collide. Match tiles by color and shape to clear the field and outmaneuver the chaos of shifting patterns and escalating modifiers.

Core Features

  • Match with Momentum
    Clear tiles by matching pairs or trios - no dragging, just sharp reflexes and smart positioning.

  • Modifiers That Matter
    Activate powerful gameplay modifiers to reshape your strategy. Stack them for brutal challenges that give a chance for a better score.

  • Physics-Driven Gameplay
    Tiles don’t just sit still—they slide, bounce, and react to your moves. Master the flow to control the chaos.

  • Stylized Sci-Fi Aesthetic
    Immerse yourself in a sleek neon world with dynamic shaders, crisp UI, and a pulsing electronic soundtrack.

  • Built for Replayability
    Climb the leaderboards, chase high scores, and experiment with different modifier combos. Every run is a new storm.

Whether you're chasing the perfect combo or just vibing with the visuals, Tile Tempest offers a fresh twist on the match genre - easy to pick up, hard to master, and impossible to put down.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA GTX 1050 or better)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Precision meets chaos in this fast-paced, physics-driven tile matcher. Memorize colors and shapes, adapt to shifting modifiers, and stay sharp under pressure. In this storm, your memory is your greatest weapon.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
